The girth-eight argument and no eight-edge differences prove the sharp minimum. Both included codes executed successfully from their actual artifact paths.

value.rationale: A Hamiltonicity-preserving exchange threshold and the entire short-move connectivity metric are natural in travelling-salesperson local search and the combinatorics of symmetric cubic graphs. Unlike total matching-graph connectivity, every intermediate Hamiltonian tour remains feasible. Exact seven choices and four-trade diameter provide a meaningful structural benchmark; the result is finite and motivated, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
